Class TileLoader

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Loader.Loader<Tiles>
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Loader.TileLoader
public class TileLoader extends Loader<Tiles>
Responsible for loading and creating a list of Component objects based on the data contained in the tiles.json file. This class handles parsing the file, generating the tiles, and assigning each one a unique ID.
